text:
maya: DeployBot triggered release window for tonight 23:00 UTC. Plan: runtime 2.3.1 -> API 1.9.0 -> Console 4.5. Router needs header-split and pin. Can teams confirm no veto?

deploybot: [automated] Scheduled canary wave at 2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Timeout 30m. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/release/runbooks/slim-rollover

zach: Runtime ok from my side. KV cache bump + quantization profile applied. No infra changes.

emily: API change includes header name change: 'x-rw-session' -> 'x-rw-sess'. Backwards compat handled by feature flag for 48h.

sophie: Console needs schema migration for the header mapping. I can push migration at +10m into window.

zach: Router: header-split requires new route rule to preserve stickiness. Need pin on router instances to avoid evictions during migration. Marking router pin requested.

maya: Confirming pin required. Sophie, can console migration run without dropping live sessions? If not, we should stagger Console + Router.

sophie: It will preserve sessions if router keeps old header around for 1h. I propose stagger: runtime -> api -> router pin -> console migrate.

emily: Rollback plan: API canary rollback to v1.8.9 with flag off. Runtime rollback is image revert to 2.3.0. Console rollback is config flip. Router rollback unpin and revert route rule.

maya: Ops: can you set the drain window on subnet a minute before router pin? We saw sticky sessions dropped when drain overlapped in last run.

ops-bot: Note: subnet-drain scheduled at 22:58 UTC on 2026-03-23 for 2m. Recommend setting drain to soft-drain mode to avoid eviction.

zach: Commands I'll run (dry-run):
```
redwoodctl deploy runtime --image runtime:2.3.1 --dry-run
redwoodctl pin router --variants router-v2 --until 2026-03-23T23:40:00Z
```

emily: I'll stage API canary on 10% traffic for first 5m; if error-rate < 0.5% we proceed. Alert if >1%.

maya: Ok team. If no objections, we'll proceed with the stagger: runtime (23:00), api canary (23:05), router pin (23:15), console migrate (23:25). I'll post final rollcall 22:45 UTC.

sophie: :thumbsup:

zach: :rocket:
